what: Backend dependency vulnerability scan (audit case SEC-005), env + requirements
method: pip-audit 2.10.1 against the installed virtualenv (includes transitive dependencies) and against backend/requirements.txt top-level pins. Requires network access to the advisory databases; no project dependency was added - pip-audit is installed in a throwaway venv.

findings.name: djangorestframework
findings.note: Recorded by the first scan run. The project pin `djangorestframework>=3.15,<3.17` excluded every fixed release, so the advisories were un-patchable without changing the pin. requirements.txt now pins >=3.17.2,<4.0 and the environment is on 3.18.3.

not_applicable: Frontend: no package.json and no bundler, so there is no npm dependency surface to scan.
